title: Awaken-HI: Scaling Humanoid Intelligence with Whole-Body Human Experience
abstract: arXiv:2611.26420v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A central goal of humanoid robotics is for robots to perform the everyday work people do in homes and workplaces. Existing egocentric video datasets cover many of these activities but provide little synchronized whole-body motion data for learning loco-manipulation at scale. We build Awaken-Human, which pairs approximately 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body human motion and covers more than 100 skills. Building on this, we also introduce Awaken-HI (Humanoid Intelligence), a vision-language-action model for humanoid loco-manipulation that jointly predicts original human motion and retargeted robot actions through a shared action expert. We show that loco-manipulation skills transfer more effectively from people to humanoids when human trajectories directly supervise the shared action expert. translated_title: Awaken-HI：利用全身人类经验扩展人形智能
translated_abstract: 人形机器人技术的核心目标是让机器人在家庭和工作场所中执行人们的日常工作。现有的自我中心视角视频数据集涵盖了许多这类活动，但缺乏用于大规模学习移动-操作技能的同步全身运动数据。我们构建了Awaken-Human数据集，将约50,000小时的第一人称立体视频与同步的全身人体运动配对，涵盖超过100种技能。在此基础上，我们还推出了Awaken-HI（Humanoid Intelligence），一个面向人形机器人移动-操作的视觉-语言-动作模型，它通过共享的动作专家联合预测原始人体运动和重定向后的机器人动作。我们证明，当人类轨迹直接监督共享动作专家时，移动-操作技能能够更有效地从人类迁移到人形机器人。增加人类预训练数据能够按照经验缩放规律降低留出集上的机器人动作预测误差。
tldr: 该论文构建了包含5万小时第一人称视频与同步全身人体运动、覆盖100余种技能的大规模数据集Awaken-Human，并提出视觉-语言-动作模型Awaken-HI，通过共享动作专家以人类轨迹直接监督机器人动作学习，实现了移动-操作技能从人类到人形机器人的高效迁移。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Awaken-Human, a large-scale dataset pairing 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body motion across 100+ skills, and Awaken-HI, a vision-language-action model whose shared action expert is directly supervised by human trajectories, enabling effective transfer of loco-manipulation skills from humans to humanoids.
